articles.title: Crypto-friendly bank Erebor in talks to raise $1.5 billion at $9.5 billion valuation: FT
articles.snippet: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.

articles.title: Coinbase picks Abu Dhabi for its global tokenized asset push
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange said it secured regulatory approval to offer tokenized securities from Abu Dhabi as the emirate deepens its push into onchain finance.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck below $65,000 as Hormuz hopes evaporate, XRP close to dropping below $1
articles.snippet: The Strait of Hormuz relief trade unraveled after Trump demanded 50 years of Iranian compensation, pushing oil back to $89 and leaving crypto and equities unchanged ahead of a pivotal CPI report.

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.snippet: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.snippet: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.
